{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('../data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
df_duplicates = df[duplicate_patients]

print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patients: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {df_duplicates.shape[0]}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
missing_baseline = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {missing_baseline}")

# Check assay_batch values
print(f"Assay batch distribution: {df['assay_batch'].value_counts().to_dict()}")

# Check sample_seq distribution per patient
sample_seq_max = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f"Max sample_seq per patient: {sample_seq_max.max()}")
print(f"Number of patients with sample_seq > 1: {sample_seq_max[sample_seq_max > 1].count()}")"}
